title: bacon and bacon salad
steps: preheat oven to 400°f.
combine potatoes, onion, potatoes, bacon, butter and cayenne.
mix well.
place in a 2-quart skillet and cook until potatoes are tender.
stir in butter and cay.
toss with remaining bacon.
bake at 350°f for about 10 minutes.
cool completely before serving.

title: potatoes with egg
steps: in a large pot, combine potatoes, onion and eggs.
add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
reduce heat to medium.
reduce heat to low.
stir in potatoes and onion.
cook for 3-4 minutes.
remove from heat.
drain and set aside.
combine the potatoes, egg and salt in a bowl.
combine the bread crumbs and sugar.
add the potatoes, egg, salt and pepper.
mix well.
cover and cook on low for 2-3 hours.
remove from heat and cool completely.

reference_title: frank sinatra's sausage and green peppers
title: chinese sausage
steps: combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl.
stir in sausage.
add meat mixture and mix well.
add sausage mixture and mix well again.
add hot italian sausage.
pour over the sausage.
sprinkle with chopped onions.
place on greased cookie sheet.
bake in oven for 25 minutes.
cool slightly.

title: cauliflower bread
steps: mix together the sour cream, onion and milk.
add to the cauliflower.
toss well.
place in a greased 2 quart casserole dish.
cover with foil and bake at 400 for 40 minutes.

title: potato salad with sour cream
steps: in a large bowl, combine potatoes, onion, mushrooms and garlic.
mix well.
drain and stir in parmesan cheese.
mix in remaining ingredients.
stir in dill.
sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve.

title: ham and potatoes
steps: combine potatoes, onion, bacon, ham, salt, chile pequin and egg.
bring to a boil.
reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
remove from heat and set aside.
mix together potatoes, onion, ham, salt and pepper in a bowl.
stir in eggs, milk, and salt.
mix well.
stir in flour, sugar and salt.
stir in milk and mix well.
add ham and cook for 30 minutes or until thickened and browned.
serve with sour cream or other sour cream.

title: blackberry bread
steps: preheat oven to 400 degrees f.
preheat oven racks to 400 degrees f and grease and flour a 12 x 9\

title: sweet maple syrup cookies
steps: place dry ingredients in a small bowl and mix well.
pour into cookie sheet.
bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

title: crock pot cookie dough
steps: mix flour, cornmeal and baking powder together.
beat in eggs, milk and salt.
stir in milk and mix well.
sprinkle with flour mixture.
bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
cool completely.
sprinkle with remaining flour mixture.
bake at 350 for 15-20 minutes or until golden.

title: chocolate brownie
steps: preheat oven to 375 degrees.
in a large bowl, combine flour, cornflours, baking soda, and milk.
add to the wet ingredients and mix well.
pour into greased 9x13 baking dish.
bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: cheesy cabbage
steps: preheat oven to 350°f.
place cabbage in a shallow bowl.
mix margarine, velveleta, cheese and cabbage in a bowl.
cover and let stand 20 minutes.
chill, uncovered, until cheese is melted.
place cabbage in refrigerator.
cut cabbage into bite size pieces.
roll out of the cabbage, and place in a greased 13x9 inch baking pan.
bake at 350°f for 30 minutes, until golden brown.

title: english muffins
steps: preheat oven to 350°f.
spray muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray.
in a large bowl, mix flour, baking soda and salt.
combine egg yolks, milk, and sausage in large bowl.
stir in flour mixture.
beat on medium speed until smooth.
add remaining ingredients, mixing well.
pour batter evenly over muffin cups.
bake at 350°f for 25-30 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned on both sides.
remove from oven and cool on wire rack for 15 minutes.
